definitions.gloss: newcomer; new member; new arrival; latecomer
definitions.explanation: A person who has recently joined a group, organization, community, or field. Often contrasted with established or senior members.

examples.japanese: {新参|しんざん}{者|もの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わからないこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There's a lot that newcomers don't understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{新参|しんざん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ほど⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I'm still a newcomer in this industry, so there's a mountain of things to learn.

examples.japanese: {新参|しんざん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧はまってしまった。
examples.english: I'm a new fan, but I've completely fallen for the charm of this work.

notes:
A compound of {新|しん} (new) and {参|ざん} (joining, participating). Can be used as a standalone noun or as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. The opposite is ⟦{古参|こさん}→古参：06288_kosan⟧ (old-timer, veteran member).

USAGE:
Common in both traditional and modern contexts. In online communities, {新参|しんざん} and ⟦{古参|こさん}→古参：06288_kosan⟧ are frequently used to distinguish between new and long-standing fans or members. Can carry a slight sense of being an outsider who hasn't yet earned full standing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新参|しんざん}{者|もの} — newcomer (with the person suffix)
- {新参|しんざん}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ — new fan
- {新参|しんざん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ — new entrant (company)
- {新参|しんざん}お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ — no newcomers allowed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{古参|こさん}→古参：06288_kosan⟧ — old-timer, veteran member (opposite)
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧ — new person, rookie (more for workplace/professional contexts)
- {新入|しんにゅう}り — newcomer, new arrival (more general, less about group dynamics)
